title: Senu
caption: Agent Dashboard for tmux
description: Senu started during my PayPal internship, when I tried moving my tmux setup to herdr. I liked its agent detection but wanted to stay in tmux, so I brought it into a few status-bar scripts that grew into Senu.

It watches Claude Code and Codex panes, marks each window working, blocked, done, or idle, and chimes when an agent needs you. Popups jump to any agent or show usage limits and cost across accounts. Built with TypeScript, Bun, and OpenTUI, it ports herdr's detection engine and ships as a single binary.
seoDescription: Senu is a terminal dashboard that shows the state of Claude Code and Codex agents in tmux and tracks usage limits and cost across accounts.
